facts.fact: Expertise France states the government launched the SmartBots Fourth Industrial Revolution Digital Transformation Strategy in February 2020 to accelerate digital transformation across all sectors; no adopting act or approving body is named.

The EU, France's foreign ministry, ESTDEV and HAUS Finland fund a EUR 4.85 million project running August 2024 to August 2027 that supports SmartBots governance, a monitoring and evaluation framework and a progress dashboard; no domestic allocation to the strategy is stated.
